argv: SELECT metric||'='||value FROM (SELECT 'PROJECT_SCHEMA_COUNT' metric,count(*)::bigint value FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = ANY (ARRAY['raw','core','provenance','research','rights','workflow','release','audit','api_v1','exploration_v3','api_v3']) UNION ALL SELECT 'V3_ENUM',count(*) FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname='exploration_v3' AND t.typtype='e' UNION ALL SELECT 'V3_TABLE',count(*) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='exploration_v3' AND c.relkind='r' UNION ALL SELECT 'V3_FUNCTION',count(*) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='exploration_v3' UNION ALL SELECT 'V3_CONSTRAINT_TRIGGER',count(*) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='exploration_v3' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgconstraint<>0 UNION ALL SELECT 'V3_REGULAR_TRIGGER',count(*) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='exploration_v3' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgconstraint=0 UNION ALL SELECT 'V50_ADDITIVE_VIEW',count(*) FROM pg_views WHERE schemaname IN ('api_v3','exploration_v3') OR (schemaname='audit' AND viewname='exploration_v3_inventory') UNION ALL SELECT 'GOVERNED_TABLE_COUNT',count(*) FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = ANY (ARRAY['raw','core','provenance','research','rights','workflow','release','audit','exploration_v3']) UNION ALL SELECT 'API_V3_VIEW_COUNT',count(*) FROM pg_views WHERE schemaname='api_v3' UNION ALL SELECT 'REVIEWER_QUEUE_COUNT',(SELECT count(*) FROM exploration_v3.reviewer_association_queue) UNION ALL SELECT 'V3_INVENTORY_NONZERO_METRIC_COUNT',(SELECT count(*) FROM audit.exploration_v3_inventory i CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(i)) e WHERE e.value::bigint<>0)) m ORDER BY metric;
